apps.whats_new:
48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.38.1 - A NEW MEETINGS WINDOW; PRAYER POINTS KEEP THEIR ITEMS (and Website Update 85)
  - Meetings… has a new look: the meeting and the date at the top for every tab, the tabs as buttons, white cards with flat
    modern buttons. Prayer groups in 3 steps: 1 Prayer points (with their items), 2 Make this week's groups, 3 The groups.
  - Prayer points keep their items. A new prayer meeting starts from the last one: its points with their items, which points
    go together and the number of groups (else the usual points).
  - Prayer groups → "Publish to the portal": these points with their items (and which go together, and the number of
    groups) become the usual ones and go to the phones at once; this meeting's groups get them too.
  - The 4 printed Sunday QR cards moved to the check-in window (Check-in at church → Printed QR cards for Sundays). The
    Sunday service check-in is the QR check-in; Meetings… is for the other meetings.
  - The member portal does the same (Website Update 85).
